description: The full text of one job from search, with its posting URL and match details, for citing it. Reads only.

id.description: A job id from a search result.

name: fetch

metadata.description: The posting's facts beside its text.

application_status.description: The application's ledger status when the user applied, else null.

match_score.description: The match score against the user, from 0 to 100.

posted_at.description: When the posting went up, ISO 8601 in UTC.

salary.description: The pay the posting states, or null when it states none.

currency.description: ISO code of the stated pay.

max.description: Highest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

min.description: Lowest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

period.description: What the amounts are for (year, month, week, day or hour) when the posting states a period ApplySent recognizes.

title.description: The posting's title and employer in one line.

url.description: The employer's posting URL, for citing it.

title: Fetch a job's text
